data.reply: The tree holds together, but three key results still describe activity rather than an outcome.

findings.title: Two key results have no baseline in their target
findings.why: Without a starting number nobody can tell at the end of the quarter whether these moved. Both name the goal but not where they are today.

findings.title: Marketing owns nine key results this quarter
findings.why: That is more than one team can hold in its head, and the tree gives no signal about which of them the company objective actually needs. Which three matter?
